# Definitional Conflict

This folder captures instances where clinical narratives and formal data definitions clash within the healthcare quality indicators. It documents specific cases where broad clinical goals, such as the intent for patients to resume oral nutrition, conflict with rigid technical coding requirements, creating ambiguity in how performance is measured and reported.

## Pages

- [[definitional-conflict|Definitional Conflict]] — Documents the ambiguity between the clinical goal of resuming oral nutrition and the strict ZZ2009C/D coding requirements for Indicator 7.
